about: Text values the publish tool's settings writer writes, as it writes them. A reader that follows YAML 1.1 (Obsidian, PyYAML, js-yaml) reads an unquoted 12:30 as the number 750 and an unquoted yes as true, so the writer quotes those. Both sides read `written` back as `value`: tools/publish/test/yaml-shared-cases.test.js (the writer, and the yaml package in both 1.2 and 1.1 mode) and tests/test_yaml_shared_cases.py (vaultlib's frontmatter reader).
